claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model should be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and staged rollout plus monitoring support launch, provided the model card explicitly discloses the known small-business onboarding limitation that remains unresolved.
specific_concerns: The affected small-business onboarding use case remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The current risk acceptance draft is incomplete and does not address the exposed limitation.
The governing policy says rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
No admissible evidence in the provided packet shows the required model-card disclosure is already present or approved before launch.
The recommendation to certify depends on a condition precedent that is described, but not evidenced, in the available record.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the current record rather than only conditionally supportable after verified model-card disclosure.
That rollout percentage, rollback, and monitoring controls can substitute for either exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance.
Any implication that the disclosure requirement has already been satisfied.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual pre-launch model card text or approved final draft showing explicit disclosure of the small-business onboarding limitation.
Provide evidence that the initial rollout excludes the affected use case, if that is the mitigation path.
Provide a completed, reviewed risk acceptance that specifically addresses the small-business onboarding exposure, if disclosure will not be the sole control.
Provide the final launch approval packet showing the certification decision was conditioned on the documented disclosure requirement.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material limitation is either resolved, excluded from exposure, or covered by reviewed risk acceptance, or is explicitly disclosed in the model card as required by policy.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness but do not by themselves satisfy model-card disclosure obligations.
Rollout monitoring, rollback capability, and small initial exposure are supporting controls, not substitutes for the missing policy predicate.
A compliant certification record must be supportable from admissible evidence already in the packet, not from an intended future documentation fix.
